scene: The weaver gasps and unlocks three transit gates.
picture: On a flat cobblestone quay, a brass spiral lift cage waits open on the far left. Left of centre stands the woman in her lilac headscarf and mustard coat, holding the blue silk map beside the smiling weaver. In the centre sits a red cable tram, and on the far right, a green river barge.
shown: A brass spiral lift cage with open gate stands on the far left.
A red mountain cable tram waits on rails in the centre.
A green wooden river barge bobs at a dock on the far right.
